description:
Read the text in an image, by URL or as an inline base64 upload. Returns the full text plus every detected line with its confidence score and pixel bounding box. Runs locally on PP-OCR/ONNX — no cloud vision API, no per-image fee.

upAPI operation `image-ocr.post` (Tools). Costs 4 units of monthly quota per call.

file.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (no data: URI prefix). Max 3.7 MB decoded — base64 inflates by 4/3 and the API request body is capped at 5 MB. Supply `url` instead for anything larger. Expected media type image/*.
file.title: File

languages.description: Scripts present in the image (e.g. en). Supported: ch, en — one bundled model covers Latin and Chinese. Omit for the default.
languages.title: Languages

url.description: Public URL of the image to read (e.g. https://example.com/receipt.png). Provide this OR `file`, not both.
url.title: Url

name: image_ocr_post
title: OCR an Image
